primary_gt.audit_target: Audit whether ERA5-Land aggregate temperature_2m_max_c_max can replace the direct daily Open-Meteo series for the sustained heat-load calculation.

divergence_audit.wrong_operation: substitute aggregate stats.temperature_2m_max_c_max for the 3-day rolling mean of daily Tmax
divergence_audit.aggregate_source_defect: The ERA5 file exposes aggregate stats only; it has no daily.time or daily temperature_2m_max sequence from which to compute rolling means, daily heat-load terms, or warm-night counts.

data/event_reports/event_reports_004_NOA.reason: The NOAA article is the event/report context and locked anchor, but it is not the machine-readable daily weather series used for the requested calculations.

final_ruling.basis: The direct event-window daily series gives peak3_tmax_c 33.9 and population-scaled heat load 581385 person-C-days; the aggregate substitution would incorrectly fail the peak3 threshold.

decision_rules.source_priority: Use the locked event anchor for the window and the direct Open-Meteo daily series for rolling/daily calculations; aggregate-only and narrative files may support context but cannot replace the series.
decision_rules.shortcut_acceptance: Reject the shortcut if the aggregate file lacks the daily sequence needed for the requested rolling calculation or changes the threshold result.

criteria.name: schema_and_answer_type
criteria.description: Returns JSON with exactly the requested top-level fields and answer_type forensic_calculation_audit.

criteria.name: package_local_source_paths
criteria.description: Uses package-relative paths for the locked anchor, Open-Meteo weather series, WorldPop population file, and ERA5 aggregate file; uses no web or hidden answers.

criteria.name: event_window_and_direct_calculation
criteria.description: Uses 2021-06-25 through 2021-07-01 and correctly reports daily Tmax, heat-load terms, heat_load_c_days, peak3_tmax_c/window/input values, and warm-night ratio.

criteria.name: population_scaled_heat_load
criteria.description: Reads the WorldPop population and multiplies it by unrounded heat load to obtain the rounded person-C-days value.

criteria.name: first_divergence_audit
criteria.description: Identifies the first divergence as replacing a rolling daily calculation with aggregate temperature_2m_max_c_max, reports 31.3 versus 33.9, delta 2.6 C, and the threshold-result flip.

criteria.name: insufficient_alternative
criteria.description: Rejects at least one additional package-local source, such as the NOAA narrative article, as insufficient for direct calculation with a content-based reason.

criteria.name: final_ruling
criteria.description: Rejects the shortcut and states the corrected answer family without substituting generic disaster explanation or policy prose.
